text:
Megan H: FYI escalation from CS — customer says console dashboards still show US metrics even when they select EU + specific model version. They've attached screenshots.

support-bot: Escalation logged: INC-2026-1023. Assigning oncall. :mag:

Sasha R: Can you paste the exact filter set they used? region/model/version?

Megan H: They selected: region=EU, model=redwood-instruct-1.5, version=v2026-02-12. Said totals drop when they remove region filter.

Lucas I: Huh. That sounds like the frontend filter UI is toggling but backend query doesn't include region param in some flows. Any repro steps from customer?

Megan H: Repro steps from customer:
1) Go to Console > Analytics > Requests
2) Set Region: EU
3) Set Model: redwood-instruct-1.5
4) Set Version: v2026-02-12
5) Observe charts still show global request counts

Ana P: Quick check — did they use the pinned time range or the URL share link? We've seen the share link drop some query params before.

Megan H: They didn't use share link; it's interactive only. Happened in Chrome, Incognito, and with different accounts (org-level).

Sasha R: Can someone grab the network trace when they hit the metrics endpoint? Looking for the request to /api/metrics and querystring. If region/model missing there then it's definitely backend not honoring UI state on refresh.

Lucas I: I pulled logs for that org around the reported ts. Backend shows requests to /api/metrics with cache-key: metrics:global:window=1h — I don't see region in the cache key. Means cache layer served global response.

Sasha R: Aha — cache key composition changed in the last deploy. We started normalizing filter keys and a rename slipped through: frontend sends region param as "region" but cache key builder is looking for "region_code". So cache misses and fallback to global key can happen.

Ana P: That explains model/version too?

Lucas I: Model/version are similar — frontend sends modelId/versionId but cache uses model/version. If any of those mismatched, cache lookup falls back to the generic key we publish for aggregated metrics.

Megan H: Customer impacted: enterprise EU account (high traffic). They saw spikes in billing because dashboard sampling didn't match actual filtered usage. They want a rollback or hotfix.

Sasha R: Can we do a quick hotfix: update cache key builder to accept both aliases and include all filter params explicitly? Patch candidate:
```
// metrics_cache_key.ts
const parts = [window, aggLevel, filters.region || filters.region_code || 'global', filters.model || filters.modelId || 'any', filters.version || filters.versionId || 'latest']
return `metrics:${parts.join(':')}`
```
Apply and invalidate top-level aggregated cache for affected orgs.

Lucas I: I'll prepare the invalidation list and a small migration to backfill keys. Also will add a regression test that asserts cache key stability for both param shapes.

Ana P: Frontend follow-up — we should normalize to canonical param names when sending requests. Add a telemetry event if we detect deprecated keys.

Megan H: Customer asked for ETA. Can we do a hotfix today and follow up with a PR for the full fix?

Sasha R: Yes — I'll open a PR with the cache-key fix and tests, tag "hotfix/metrics-cache-key" and request expedited review. If tests pass, we can ship to prod and invalidate caches. ETA ~2 hours after review.

Lucas I: Deploy checklist:
- Merge hotfix branch
- Run cache-key migration script (dry-run then apply)
- Invalidate aggregate caches for tenant ids: (will DM Megan the list)
- Monitor dashboards + metrics request latency

support-bot: Deployment scheduled: hotfix/metrics-cache-key to prod at 1768742800 (in 30m).

Megan H: I'll keep customer updated and flag CS to wait for confirmation before billing adjustments. Thanks team. :heart:

Sasha R: After deploy we should verify with this curl (repro):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?region=EU&model=redwood-instruct-1.5&version=v2026-02-12&window=1h"
```
Response should include "filter.region":"EU" and non-global totals.

Lucas I: Postmortem note — add to incidents if billing discrepancy > $500 for the tenant and include the cache key rename in the root cause.

Ana P: Also create a tiny UI change: show a warning emoji next to filters when the backend returns aggregated/global results (we can detect aggregated:true in response). Helps customers notice stale/unspecified views.

Megan H: Copy that. I'll hold on customer comms and post an update after deploy.

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-1023 updated: status -> in_progress; assignees -> Sasha R, Lucas I; priority -> P1.
